decision.question: review size
decision.why: Server check plus one merge.mjs hook; no page change

findings.text: Half the ask isn't in the diff being reviewed. requirements.md says "if the existing count is large, report it first: list the offenders on /live/plan/ui-kit/" and "where the kit lacks a part that the Figma card system has, list it and don't build it." Both were written, but only as an uncommitted edit to `public/live/plan/ui-kit/page.jsonl` sitting in the main working tree (`git status` shows it modified, not committed) — it is not in `review/diff.patch`, and the branch under review (`worktree/qf-3`, one commit `58b568322`) never touches that file. Per the project's own rule ("Main site is production" — edits go worktree → check_page → merge, never straight into the main tree), this change needs to move into the branch and land through merge.mjs like the rest of step 5, or it will be lost/overwritten and the owner's ask goes unmet. A fresh agent reading only `diff.patch` would conclude this half of the requirement was never built.

The plan-page text links the doc as `/Server/doc/own-css.md`, but `Server/` is dev-only tooling, not served under `public/`, so that link 404s on the live site; once moved into the branch (finding 1), fix it to the on-disk path `Server/doc/own-css.md` without a leading slash, matching how the rest of the plan page links things, or drop the link.

`OwnCSS.declarations()` is a regex, not a CSS parser, and a literal `;` inside a value (e.g. a `data:` URI or a quoted string with a semicolon) can split one declaration into a mismatched pair of matches; `Server/doc/own-css.md` already states this caveat plainly ("The count is a regex, not a CSS parser"), and spot-checks (`a:hover`, an `@supports` condition, an attribute selector containing `:`) all counted correctly, so this is pre-existing, documented risk rather than a new bug — flagging only so the next person doesn't rediscover it.

answer.reply: declined: /live/plan/ui-kit/ is a plan page written through the page tools (page_set appends to its page.jsonl; that is the standard live path for plan and done cards, and no code changes). It is committed straight to compliance/dev now, next to this merge, so it is neither lost nor uncommitted.
noted: /Server/doc/nav-check.md and /Server/readme.md both answer 200 on the dev site, so /Server/doc/own-css.md resolves once this lands.
noted: a known limit, already stated in own-css.md; a ; inside a data: URI makes it over-count, which can only produce a false refusal, and --own-css overrides that.

complete.outcome: merge.mjs now refuses a branch that grows a page's own CSS outside the kit (Server/OwnCSS.mjs, --own-css overrides); the census and Figma gaps are on /live/plan/ui-kit/ card 5
evidence: probe commit adding 2 declarations to LivePage.css refused 484 → 486, exit 1
